<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Build an on-demand windows-latest job so this repo can see its own Windows failure count, instead of depending on a downstream volunteer running our suite on their laptop. Warn-launch, dispatch-only, and it must report SKIPS so a green cannot mean 'we stopped looking'.
